verdict.rationale: Ramp documents a native QuickBooks integration that syncs accounting fields and transactions in real time, plus NetSuite and Xero integrations and GL-account auto-coding. Accounting categories, tracking categories and departments exist as data objects. However, no evidence shows finance-controlled mapping rules for GL account, class and department, and the NetSuite and Xero evidence covers only bill workflows, not transaction sync. Missing for 10: explicit transaction sync to NetSuite and Xero, documented user-controlled GL/class/department mapping configuration, class mapping specifically, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, transactions sync to QuickBooks, NetSuite, or Xero with GL account, class, and department mappings I control
